about_me_info_section.subTitle: TECH · DESIGN · VISIBILITY
about_me_info_section.title: Digital Solutions from a Single Source
about_me_info_section.description:
For several years, I have been designing and developing websites and digital applications. Since 2026, I have been working independently as a freelancer, combining my passion for technology with creativity. VisionIT is my sole proprietorship for web development, mobile apps, SEO, and digital solutions based in Vienna. Thanks to my experience across different areas, I support projects with a broad understanding. Straightforward, precise, and all from a single source.

Through my practical agency experience in software development, media design, and search engine optimization, I don't want to limit myself to a single discipline, but rather combine these areas in a meaningful way. It's exactly this interplay that makes my work exciting and enables solutions where technology, design, and visibility are considered together from the very start.

about_me_section.title: About Me
about_me_section.name: Lena Zyadeh, BSc.
about_me_section.description:
I am a freelance web and app developer specializing in React, Next.js, and Flutter.

I started my career at Marqably, a digital agency in Vienna, where I spent two years contributing to several digital products – including apps with hundreds of thousands of active users. This experience shaped my standards for code quality, documentation, and independent working style.

Today I work as a freelance developer on projects where both matter: a good sense for design and the technical depth to implement it properly.
